//! Produces and verifies a synthetic native V17 predecessor using unchanged public APIs.
use knx_core::{Command, CommandStack, GroupAddressStyle, Project};
use knx_store::project_history::{self as history, NativeSnapshot};
use knx_store::{Connection, StoredOpaqueEntry};
use std::{fs, path::Path};

fn schema(conn: &Connection) {
    assert_eq!(knx_core::project::CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, 17);
    assert_eq!(knx_store::CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, 17);
    let v: i64 = conn.query_row("PRAGMA user_version", [], |r| r.get(0)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(v, 17);
    let priority_table: i64 = conn.query_row("SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name='com_object_saved_priority'", [], |r| r.get(0)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(priority_table, 1, "native17 carries the captured overlay");
    let edit_table: i64 = conn.query_row("SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_schema WHERE name GLOB '*priority_edit*'", [], |r| r.get(0)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(edit_table, 0, "native17 has no user priority edit table");
    let check: String = conn.query_row("PRAGMA integrity_check", [], |r| r.get(0)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(check, "ok");
    assert!(!conn.prepare("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").unwrap().exists([]).unwrap());
}

fn image(out: &Path, name: &str, snapshot: &NativeSnapshot) {
    let bytes = snapshot.encode().unwrap();
    let hash = history::image_hash(&bytes);
    assert_eq!(NativeSnapshot::decode(&bytes, &hash).unwrap(), *snapshot);
    fs::write(out.join(format!("{name}.image")), &bytes).unwrap();
    fs::write(out.join(format!("{name}.semantic-sha256")), snapshot.semantic_hash().unwrap()).unwrap();
    fs::write(out.join(format!("{name}.debug")), format!("{snapshot:#?}\n")).unwrap();
    assert!(NativeSnapshot::decode(&bytes, &"0".repeat(64)).is_err());
}

fn model(project: &Project) -> NativeSnapshot {
    NativeSnapshot { project: project.clone(), opaque: vec![], manufacturer_refs: vec![] }
}

fn preserved(project: &Project, baseline: &Project) {
    assert_eq!(project.schema_version, 17);
    assert_eq!(project.installations, baseline.installations, "original topology must survive");
    assert_eq!(project.devices.com_objects().count(), 6);
    for original in baseline.devices.com_objects() {
        assert_eq!(project.devices.com_object(original.id).unwrap(), original);
    }
}

fn priority_evidence(opaque: &[StoredOpaqueEntry], topology: &[u8]) {
    let prefix = "/KNX/Project/Installations/Installation/Topology";
    let expectations = [
        (format!("{prefix}/Area/Line/Segment/DeviceInstance[@Id='P-0001-0_DI-1']/ComObjectInstanceRefs/ComObjectInstanceRef[@RefId='O-7_R-1']"), ""),
        (format!("{prefix}/Area/Line/Segment/DeviceInstance[@Id='P-0001-0_DI-1']/ComObjectInstanceRefs/ComObjectInstanceRef[@RefId='O-8_R-2']"), "Future-Ω"),
        (format!("{prefix}/Area/Line/Segment/DeviceInstance[@Id='P-0001-0_DI-1']/ComObjectInstanceRefs/ComObjectInstanceRef[@RefId='O-9_R-3']"), "High"),
        (format!("{prefix}/UnassignedDevices/DeviceInstance[@Id='P-0001-0_DI-2']/ComObjectInstanceRefs/ComObjectInstanceRef[@RefId='O-7_R-1']"), "Alert"),
    ];
    for (xpath, raw) in expectations {
        let rows: Vec<_> = opaque.iter().filter(|e| e.kind == "RetainedAttribute" && e.source_path == "P-0001/0.xml" && e.name == "Priority" && e.xpath == xpath).collect();
        assert_eq!(rows.len(), 1, "exact owner-keyed declaration {xpath}");
        assert_eq!(rows[0].bytes, raw.as_bytes());
        assert_eq!(rows[0].sha256, history::image_hash(raw.as_bytes()));
    }
    let source: Vec<_> = opaque.iter().filter(|e| e.kind == "ContainerEntry" && e.source_path == "P-0001/0.xml" && e.xpath.is_empty() && e.name.is_empty()).collect();
    assert_eq!(source.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(source[0].bytes, topology);
    assert_eq!(source[0].sha256, history::image_hash(topology));
    let unkeyed: Vec<_> = opaque.iter().filter(|e| e.kind == "RetainedAttribute" && e.name == "Priority" && e.xpath.is_empty()).collect();
    assert_eq!(unkeyed.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(unkeyed[0].bytes, b"Unkeyed-control");
    for entry in opaque { assert_eq!(entry.sha256, history::image_hash(&entry.bytes)); }
}

fn captured(project: &Project) {
    use knx_core::SavedInstancePriority as S;
    let mut declared: Vec<String> = vec![];
    let mut absent = 0;
    for object in project.devices.com_objects() {
        match &object.saved_instance_priority {
            S::Declared(d) => declared.push(d.raw.clone()),
            S::Absent(_) => absent += 1,
            S::Unavailable { reason } => panic!("unexpected unavailable capture {reason:?}"),
        }
    }
    declared.sort();
    assert_eq!(declared, ["", "Alert", "Future-\u{3a9}", "High"], "importer captured each declaration");
    assert_eq!(absent, 2, "attribute and element omission are captured");
}

fn verify_reopen(path: &Path, root: &NativeSnapshot, working: &NativeSnapshot, undo: &[Project], redo: &[Project], generation: i64, named_id: i64) {
    let before = fs::read(path).unwrap();
    let store = knx_store::open_existing_read_only(path).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(store.migrated_from, None);
    schema(&store.conn);
    assert_eq!(NativeSnapshot::read(&store.conn).unwrap(), *root);
    let recovered = history::load_editor(&store.conn).unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(recovered.generation, generation);
    assert_eq!(recovered.baseline, *root);
    assert_eq!(recovered.working, *working);
    assert_eq!(recovered.undo, undo);
    assert_eq!(recovered.redo, redo);
    assert_eq!(recovered.undo.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(recovered.redo.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(recovered.baseline.opaque, recovered.working.opaque);
    let versions = history::list_versions(&store.conn).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(versions.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(versions[0].reason, "named");
    assert_eq!(versions[0].label, "Synthetic V17 baseline");
    assert_eq!(versions[0].id, named_id);
    assert_eq!(history::read_version(&store.conn, named_id).unwrap(), *root);
    let mut project = recovered.working.project.clone();
    let mut stack = CommandStack::from_snapshot_states(recovered.undo, recovered.redo);
    stack.undo(&mut project).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(project, undo[1]);
    stack.undo(&mut project).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(project, undo[0]);
    assert_eq!(project, root.project);
    stack.redo(&mut project).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(project, undo[1]);
    stack.redo(&mut project).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(project, working.project);
    stack.redo(&mut project).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(project, redo[0]);
    stack.undo(&mut project).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(project, working.project);
    preserved(&project, &root.project);
    assert!(store.conn.execute("DELETE FROM project_history_state", []).is_err(), "read-only is enforced");
    drop(store);
    assert_eq!(fs::read(path).unwrap(), before, "read-only close/reopen must preserve file octets");
}

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<_> = std::env::args().collect();
    assert_eq!(args.len(), 3, "producer INPUT_DIR NEW_OUTPUT_DIR");
    let input = Path::new(&args[1]);
    let out = Path::new(&args[2]);
    fs::create_dir(out).expect("new attempt directory required");
    assert_eq!(knx_core::project::CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, 17);
    assert_eq!(knx_store::CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, 17);
    let topology = fs::read(input.join("0.xml")).unwrap();
    let info = fs::read(input.join("Project.xml")).unwrap();
    let signature = b"Synthetic unsigned import fixture; not a real signature";
    let zip = knx_testsupport::zip_with_entries(&[("P-0001.signature", signature), ("P-0001/0.xml", &topology), ("P-0001/Project.xml", &info)]);
    fs::write(out.join("synthetic-input.knxproj"), &zip).unwrap();
    let imported = knx_etsproj::import_knxproj_bytes(zip, "synthetic-native17.knxproj").unwrap();
    fs::write(out.join("original-import-report.debug"), format!("{:#?}\n", imported.report)).unwrap();
    fs::write(out.join("original-imported-project.debug"), format!("{:#?}\n", imported.project)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(imported.report.source.schema_version, 23);
    assert!(imported.report.errors.is_empty(), "synthetic project must be valid: {:?}", imported.report.errors);
    assert!(imported.manufacturer.is_empty());
    assert!(imported.master_metadata_error.is_none());
    assert_eq!(imported.project.devices.iter().count(), 2);
    assert_eq!(imported.project.devices.com_objects().count(), 6);
    assert_eq!(imported.project.installations.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(imported.project.installations[0].topology.areas.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(imported.project.installations[0].topology.lines.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(imported.project.installations[0].topology.unassigned.len(), 1);
    let mut opaque: Vec<_> = imported.opaque.iter().map(|e| StoredOpaqueEntry {
        source_path: e.source_path.clone(), xpath: e.xpath.clone(), kind: format!("{:?}", e.kind), name: e.name.clone(), bytes: e.bytes.clone(), sha256: e.sha256.clone(),
    }).collect();
    // Deliberately external, unkeyed opaque control, added via public passthrough APIs.
    // The four keyed declarations and original whole source above come from the importer.
    opaque.push(StoredOpaqueEntry { source_path: "P-0001/0.xml".into(), xpath: String::new(), kind: "RetainedAttribute".into(), name: "Priority".into(), bytes: b"Unkeyed-control".to_vec(), sha256: history::image_hash(b"Unkeyed-control") });
    priority_evidence(&opaque, &topology);
    let root = NativeSnapshot { project: imported.project, opaque, manufacturer_refs: vec![] };
    captured(&root.project);
    let path = out.join("native17-before-priority-edit.sqlite");
    let conn = knx_store::open_and_migrate(&path).unwrap();
    schema(&conn);
    knx_store::save_project_with_passthrough(&conn, &root.project, &root.opaque, &root.manufacturer_refs).unwrap();
    schema(&conn);
    assert_eq!(NativeSnapshot::read(&conn).unwrap(), root);
    let generation = history::save_editor(&conn, &root, &CommandStack::new(), None, true).unwrap();
    schema(&conn);
    let generation = history::create_version(&conn, &root, "Synthetic V17 baseline", generation).unwrap();
    let named_id = history::list_versions(&conn).unwrap()[0].id;
    let line_device = root.project.devices.iter().find(|d| d.source.ets_id == "P-0001-0_DI-1").unwrap().id;
    let unassigned_device = root.project.devices.iter().find(|d| d.source.ets_id == "P-0001-0_DI-2").unwrap().id;
    let mut working = root.clone();
    let mut stack = CommandStack::new();
    stack.do_command(&mut working.project, Command::RenameDevice { device: line_device, name: "Synthetic working sensor".into() }).unwrap();
    stack.do_command(&mut working.project, Command::SetGroupAddressStyle { style: GroupAddressStyle::Free }).unwrap();
    stack.do_command(&mut working.project, Command::RenameDevice { device: unassigned_device, name: "Synthetic redo sensor".into() }).unwrap();
    stack.undo(&mut working.project).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(stack.history_lengths(), (2, 1));
    assert_ne!(root.project, working.project);
    let (undo, redo) = stack.snapshot_states(&working.project).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(undo[0], root.project);
    for project in undo.iter().chain(redo.iter()).chain([&working.project]) { preserved(project, &root.project); }
    let generation = history::save_editor(&conn, &working, &stack, Some(generation), false).unwrap();
    schema(&conn);
    assert_eq!(NativeSnapshot::read(&conn).unwrap(), root);
    image(out, "baseline-complete", &root);
    image(out, "baseline-model", &model(&root.project));
    image(out, "working-complete", &working);
    image(out, "working-model", &model(&working.project));
    for (i, p) in undo.iter().enumerate() { image(out, &format!("undo-{i}"), &model(p)); }
    for (i, p) in redo.iter().enumerate() { image(out, &format!("redo-{i}"), &model(p)); }
    fs::write(out.join("generation.txt"), generation.to_string()).unwrap();
    drop(conn);
    verify_reopen(&path, &root, &working, &undo, &redo, generation, named_id);
    verify_reopen(&path, &root, &working, &undo, &redo, generation, named_id);
    priority_evidence(&working.opaque, &topology);
    // Exercise named restoration on an independent copy, never alter the frozen witness.
    let control = out.join("named-restore-control.sqlite");
    fs::copy(&path, &control).unwrap();
    let conn = knx_store::open_existing_and_migrate(&control).unwrap();
    schema(&conn);
    let restored = history::restore_version(&conn, named_id, &working, generation).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(restored.working, root);
    assert_eq!(NativeSnapshot::read(&conn).unwrap(), root);
    let editor = history::load_editor(&conn).unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(editor.working, root);
    assert!(editor.undo.is_empty() && editor.redo.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(history::list_versions(&conn).unwrap().len(), 2);
    schema(&conn);
    drop(conn);
    fs::write(out.join("producer-result.txt"), "PASS: schema17 before/after saves; captured declarations=4 absent=2; import errors=0; exact Project/opaque equality; root distinct from working; undo=2 redo=1 named=1; close/read-only reopen twice unchanged; recovered undo/redo replay; authentic image decode/hash refusal controls; named restore on independent copy\n").unwrap();
    println!("PASS native17 predecessor: objects=6 devices=2 undo=2 redo=1 named=1 generation={generation}");
}
